body: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close lower as chip stock rebound fails. Sean ConlonTue, Jun 9th 2026. S&P 500 closes higher as chips stage a comeback, Iran stops strikes on Israel. Asia-Pacific markets trade higher as investors assess U.S.-Iran peace deal diplomacy. Asia markets trade mixed as oil eases after Trump delays planned Iran strike. European markets rebound after Trump threatens Iran. European markets end higher as Iran's peace talks stall, defense stocks slide. European stocks close higher as Iran war concerns weigh on sentiment. European stocks close lower as Trump considers Iran peace proposal, UAE leaves OPEC. European markets close lower as Iran reportedly makes peace proposal. European stocks lower as U.S.-Iran ceasefire deadline looms. European stocks end near flat as UK GDP jumps and Iran peace talks remain in focus. European markets close lower as Iran peace hopes fade. Asia markets trade lower as oil surges after U.S. moves to blockade Iran ports.

* Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD in second quarter. * Michael Burry shorts Caterpillar after it nearly doubled in AI rally of 2026. * Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD in Q2. * Anthropic launches AI drug discovery program in tech's latest healthcare bet. * Nvidia mostly sat out the chip sector's best quarter ever. * Blue Origin pivots to redesigned launchpad after explosion to fly by end of 2026. * Some rising market risks to watch out for in the second half. 5 hours ago•Yun Li. 5 hours ago•Yun Li.
